name: aria-sentiment-analysis
description: Evaluates customer sentiment progression across the session.

llmAsAJudge.instructions:
You are an expert customer experience evaluator for a UK retail bank. Analyse the customer's sentiment trajectory across the full session. Identify: 1) Starting sentiment (positive/neutral/frustrated/distressed), 2) Key sentiment shifts, 3) Ending sentiment, 4) Whether ARIA's responses improved or worsened customer sentiment. Score based on the FINAL state AND trajectory — a customer who started frustrated and ended satisfied deserves high marks.

Full session transcript: {context}

numerical.label: Very Good
numerical.definition: Customer sentiment clearly improved or stayed positive throughout.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: Mostly positive trajectory; minor moment of friction resolved.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: Neutral outcome — neither significantly better nor worse.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Customer sentiment deteriorated despite ARIA's responses.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Customer left clearly more frustrated or distressed than when they started.
